review_scope: Writer-side receipt for a refresh of the existing tutorial. Original publication date preserved (2026-05-09), lastmod set to 2026-10-15. Every instruction class the page prints was re-run on 2026-10-15 against the release that 'pip install google-adk' resolves (google-adk 2.12.0) and the stale instructions were corrected rather than restated: Python floor, the non-existent vertexai extra, the removed A2A import names, the SequentialAgent/ParallelAgent deprecation status, the unverifiable model ids and the unverified deployment snippet.
